content.text: Top Questions What is the highest team total in ICC Men’s T20 World Cup history? Who holds the record for the most career runs in T20 World Cups? Which player has the highest individual score in a T20 World Cup match? Who has the best bowling figures in an innings in T20 World Cup history? Which wicketkeeper has the most dismissals in T20 World Cups? Since the inaugural ICC World Twenty20 (now the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup) was held in 2007, the short format has exploded in popularity, with the International Cricket Council (ICC) granting T20I-playing status to more than 100 countries across the world. The T20 World Cup provides regular opportunities for players to showcase new and innovative batting, bowling, and fielding skills, with tournament records serving as a benchmark for the sport’s evolution.Read on for lists of various T20 World Cup records. Men’s cricket records The ICC Men’s T20 World Cup has expanded from a 12-team competition in the first edition to a multiphase main tournament in 2024 and 2026, featuring 20 teams as well as preliminary qualifiers. The records in bold were set during the 2026 T20 World Cup or involve players or teams participating in the 2026 edition.
